description: This Java class defines the RetrieveHealthResponse, a response object for health status retrieval within a monitoring or health-check service. It encapsulates status information, handles JSON serialization/deserialization, and provides methods for creating instances and accessing status details.

classes.name: RetrieveHealthResponse
classes.description: An immutable class representing the response for a health status retrieval command. It contains status information, supports JSON serialization/deserialization, and extends command response functionalities.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of RetrieveHealthResponse with given status info and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a RetrieveHealthResponse from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: getStatusInfo
methods.description: Returns the embedded StatusInfo object representing the health status.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the status info as JSON payload into the provided JsonObjectBuilder during serialization.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer representing the resource path, which is empty for this response.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns an empty string indicating no specific resource type.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on class type, superclass equality, and statusInfo equality.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash based on superclass hash and statusInfo.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object including class name, superclass toString, and statusInfo.
